name: @signet/webmcp
description: Make website capabilities reliable and agent-ready through WebMCP.

scripts.build: node scripts/clean-dist.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node scripts/bundle-declarations.mjs
scripts.lint: npm run build && npm run lint:source
scripts.test:reference: npm run build && npx --yes --package=node@24 --package=yarn@1.22.22 yarn --cwd examples/cypress-realworld-app build && npx --yes --package=node@24 --package=yarn@1.22.22 yarn --cwd examples/cypress-realworld-app start-server-and-test start:webmcp:ci 'http://localhost:3000|http://localhost:3001' test:webmcp
scripts.test:reference:repeat: npm run build && npx --yes --package=node@24 --package=yarn@1.22.22 yarn --cwd examples/cypress-realworld-app build && npx --yes --package=node@24 --package=yarn@1.22.22 yarn --cwd examples/cypress-realworld-app start-server-and-test start:webmcp:ci 'http://localhost:3000|http://localhost:3001' test:webmcp:repeat
scripts.test:reference:native:probe: npm run build && npx --yes --package=node@24 --package=yarn@1.22.22 yarn --cwd examples/cypress-realworld-app build && npx --yes --package=node@24 --package=yarn@1.22.22 yarn --cwd examples/cypress-realworld-app start-server-and-test start:webmcp:ci 'http://localhost:3000|http://localhost:3001' test:webmcp:native:probe
scripts.test:reference:native: npm run build && npx --yes --package=node@24 --package=yarn@1.22.22 yarn --cwd examples/cypress-realworld-app build && npx --yes --package=node@24 --package=yarn@1.22.22 yarn --cwd examples/cypress-realworld-app start-server-and-test start:webmcp:ci 'http://localhost:3000|http://localhost:3001' test:webmcp:native
scripts.validate: npm run build && npm run lint:source && npm run format:check && tsc --noEmit && npm run coverage && npm run package:check && npm run smoke
